crossToolNote.zh: 无遥测窥探；注意内置浏览器插件含用户触发的 Chrome/Safari Cookie 解密导入高权限代码
crossToolNote.en: No telemetry snooping; note built-in browser plugin includes user-triggered Chrome/Safari cookie decryption via Keychain/DPAPI

oneLiner.zh: 默认零遥测，Sentry 仅在崩溃页用户主动点击 Report 才发；唯一安全提示是内置浏览器含高权限 Cookie 导入功能（需用户主动授权）。
oneLiner.en: Zero default telemetry; Sentry only fires when user clicks Report on crash page. High-privilege note: embedded browser supports user-triggered Chrome/Safari cookie import.

title.zh: 内置浏览器插件含 Keychain/DPAPI 解密导入浏览器 Cookie 能力
title.en: Built-in browser plugin can decrypt Chrome/Safari cookies on user request

summary.zh: sources.ts:464-515 通过 macOS security find-generic-password / Windows DPAPI 导入登录态到内置浏览器，需用户明确授权，非静默偷取。
summary.en: `sources.ts:464-515` uses macOS Keychain / Windows DPAPI to import browser cookies when triggered by the user; never sent to telemetry.

mitigationCommand:
# No telemetry opt-out needed.
# Decline OS Keychain prompts unless intentionally importing browser cookies.

mitigationNote.zh: 无需关遥测；如不使用内置浏览器导入登录态，遇到系统钥匙串弹窗拒绝即可。
mitigationNote.en: Zero default telemetry; simply decline Keychain prompts unless using browser cookie import.
